many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import json
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==3]
    # build grid: 0 empty, -1 walls, 2 seed? use 3 as wall color, 2 seed color, seed at (5,6)
    seeds=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==2]
    wall=set(map(tuple,[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c not in (0,2)]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # BFS from all seeds simultaneously over cells not wall; stop when a path connects two seeds? no—path between any two seeds colored
    # fill path: standard multi-source BFS until adjacency of two different-seed regions -> shortest path between closest pair
    import collections
    best=None
    for s in range(len(seeds)):
        for t in range(s+1,len(seeds)):
            dist={None}; prev={}
            start=tuple(seeds[s]); goal=tuple(seeds[t])
            q=collections.deque([(start,0)])
            seen={start}
            found=None
            while q and found is None:
                cur,d=q.popleft()
                nd=d+1
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    n=(cur[0]+di,cur[1]+dj)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and n not in seen and n not in wall:
                        seen.add(n)
                        if n==goal: found=d+1; break
                        q.append((n,nd)); prev[n]=cur
            if found is None: continue
            path=[]; n=goal
            while True:
                path.append(n); n=prev[n];
                if n is not None: path.append(n)
            path=list(reversed(path))
            if best is None or len(path)<len(best): best=path
    # now mark: cells on path that belong to either seed region... simplest: color path cells with 3, keep seed as 2, original walls stay
    for x,y in best:
        if g[x][y]==0: out[x][y]=3
    return out

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for mm in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=mm[1],int(mm[2]),int(mm[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[mm.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def segfill(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    twos=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==2]
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    pts=set(twos)
    dirs=[(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,-1)]
    done=set()
    for p in twos:
        if p in done: continue
        others=[q for q in twos if q!=p]
        for di,dj in dirs:
            i,j=p
            while True:
                n=(i+di,j+dj)
                if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or n in pts or n in done: break
                out[n[0]][n[1]]=3; done.add(n)
                i,j=n
    return out

    f={}
    def count(di,dj):
        n=0
        r,c=i+di,j+dj
        while True:
            r+=di;c+=dj
            if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
            if (r,c) in twos: n+=1; break

    total=sum(count(d,dj) for d,dj in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)])
    diag=sum(count(d,dj) for d,dj in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)])
    f['n2']=count(0,0) if cell in twos else None

import re as _re
from collections import Counter
def grids_from(fp):
    t=open(fp,encoding='utf8',errors='ignore').read()
    out=[]
    for m in _re.finditer(r'\((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        h,w=int(m[1]),int(m[2])

        rows=[r.split() for r in seg.split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

            out.append((h,w,g))
    return out

import os,glob,re
from collections import defaultdict as dd
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    G={}
    for fp in glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        txt=open(fp,encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            seg=[r.split() for r in txt[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in seg):

    return G

def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[r[:] for r in I]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]==bg: continue
            nb=[I[a][b] for a,b in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1))]
            if all(not(x==bg and True) for x in nb): pass
            if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and I[a][b]!=bg for a,b in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1))):
                res[i][j]=8
    return res
